FAQS
Find answers to your most pressing questions about our library services and membership policies.
What are the library hours?
The Library & Knowledge Resource Center is open from 8:30 AM to 6:30 PM (Monday to Saturday). Timings may vary during exams and holidays.
How to borrow books?
Registered members can borrow books by presenting their University ID card at the circulation desk. Loan limits and durations depend on the member category (students, faculty, or staff).
What is research support?
The library offers research assistance through plagiarism checking, reference management tools, citation guidance, and access to scholarly databases for academic publishing.
Are there e-resources?
Yes. The library provides access to e-books, e-journals, databases, and open-access resources through platforms like EBSCO, Knimbus, and PULOAR.
How to access OPAC?
Users can search, locate, and check the availability of library materials through the Online Public Access Catalogue (OPAC) at
http://182.72.188.195

A Journey Through Our Library's Milestones
Our library has evolved significantly over the years.
Discover the key milestones that have shaped our institution.
2015
Foundation Established
In 2015, our library was founded to serve the academic community. It began with a modest collection of books and e-resources.
2018
Library Support Expansion
Inauguration of the Library Annexe to enrich the academic life with focused resources in business, commerce, economics, and leadership. It provide the users with access to print journals, periodicals, and digital resources., fostering strategic thinking, and research among future managers and entrepreneurs.
2021
Inauguration of the Law Library
The Law Library offers a robust collection of legal texts, journals, case law, and digital databases to support legal academics iof the University. Designed as a hub for critical thinking and legal research, it empowers students and faculty to engage deeply with the foundations of justice and jurisprudence.
2016
Library RFID Integration
Embraced RFID Technology- Library has embraced cutting-edge RFID technology, redefining library operations and patron experience. From smart staff stations and intelligent security gates for book transactions.
2020
Presidency University Adopts Rajanukunte Gram Panchayat Public Library
Presidency University has taken the Rajanukunte Gram Panchayat Public Library under its CSR initiative. The Library has been responsible for the development of infrastructure, collection, and resources. This partnership has significantly enhanced the library’s facilities and services.
2025
Nomenclature Change to LKRC
The Presidency University library was renamed as the
Library & Knowledge Resource Centre (LKRC)
, reflecting its expanded role in learning, research, and knowledge dissemination.
Establishment of Law Library Annex
The university inaugurated the Law Library Annex, expanding its dedicated space for legal learning and research. The annexe strengthens access to the reference collection of legal texts, journals, and digital resources.
